species.name: rồng
species.note: a lineage rather than a body: what makes a skill about being a dragon carryable by more than one character

species.name: thằn lằn
species.note: the body, which is what a creature can be at the same time as being a dragon

species.name: thực vật
species.note: something that grows, which is what roots and photosynthesis read as; the two skills that mean it stay restricted by element, because a shared preset holds them

species.name: rùa
species.note: a shell, which withdraw was named after before it was reworded as a stance
